task.question: Which molecule, detected near the centre of the Milky Way in July 2026, was described as the first evidence of sugar in interstellar space?
task.evidence: 13 July – Astronomers announce the detection of erythrulose molecules inside a cloud of gas and dust near the centre of the Milky Way, marking the first evidence of sugar in interstellar space.
task.sonnet_answer: Glycolaldehyde (HOCH₂CHO) — though this discovery was actually announced in 2000, not July 2026. Glycolaldehyde was identified as the first sugar (a simple two-carbon monosaccharide) detected in interstellar space, found toward the galactic center region Sagittarius B2.
